_comment: Hosts and ids the forbidden-string gate lets through, each with the reason. Add nothing here without a reason.

hosts.reason: intentionally public SE hosted-demo URL, owner-approved 2026-10-27, linked from the shelf
The public name of the family lab-proxy (https://local.ping-devops.com:8443). The proxied same-origin write check compares the browser's Origin with it, so the tests must name it.
The Host name the lab-proxy sends to this lab; LAB_ALLOWED_HOSTS defaults to it in docker-compose.yml, as in the other family labs.
